'''R7-D4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] that helped aboard [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]], ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]''. He had brown markings and was a veteran of numerous battles. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] refused to give him a memory wipe, being unwilling to lose the droid's personality.

==History==
[[File:R2-D2_vs_R7-F5.png|thumb|left|200px|Ahsoka Tano breaks up a scuffle between [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and R7-D4.]]
R7-D4 was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] copilot for ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'', his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]. Before the battle, Plo Koon accompanied [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] through the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], in which they encountered [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray mantas]]. Arriving near the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], the squadron engaged the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and were able to damage its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], and when they were used, they exploded and further damaged the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] warship.

==Behind the scenes==
Plo Koon's astromech droid was originally named "R7-F5" in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' publication, but this was revised to "R7-D4" in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''. The "R7-F5" designation was later given to [[R2-Y9/Legends|another droid]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.23|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.23]],'' though it would afterwards be renamed "R2-Y9".<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>

As the [[R7-series astromech droid]] was not invented until [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] and is used exclusively with the [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]], R7-D4 is not a R7-series. However, [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s revelation that droid names are fragments of longer designations could also provide an explanation for this apparent lack of continuity.<ref name="SWI">[[Star Wars Insider 58|''Star Wars Insider'' 58]]</ref>
